title: Tractoverse — recorded decisions & running task list
text: 30 streamlines per side (nL = 30, nR = 30), old 120/side. Downsampling done densest areas top area (crown / uppermost part bundle), sparse fan stays even near apex. replaces old uniform sample.int(5577, 120) / sample.int(2397, 120). Re-implemented PERSISTED data-raw/crown-sample.R (canonical; supersedes old scratch /tmp/pa-501/logos3/crown-sample.R): crown_sample(bundle, n=30, z_frac=0.25) selects crown (points Z >= zmin + 0.25*(zmax-zmin), uppermost slab), orders streamlines crown fan position (mean X crown points), takes DETERMINISTIC even spacing (~ns/n rank step) full-width, even-near-apex coverage. make_crown_strat(path, n) writes list(iL=, iR=) index rds. replaced earlier interactive algorithm (lost; crown_strat_*.rds outputs survived). re-implementation matches original’s measured span (left crown-X ~[-48.8,-11.1], peak-Z ~[50.4,77.1]). old crown_strat_*.rds indices reproducible (interactive density thinning) - visual parity goal, validated pixels + review.

title: Install the core tractoverse packages — install_core_packages
text: packages Character vector package names. Defaults core packages (`names(tractoverse_packages())`). force Logical. `FALSE` (default) already-installed packages skipped; `TRUE` reinstalled (upgraded). branch Branch/ref install GitHub packages CRAN. Defaults `"main"`. repos CRAN repositories use, passed `install.packages()`. `NULL` user's configured `options("repos")` used. ... Additional arguments passed `install.packages()` (CRAN path) `remotes::install_github()` (GitHub path).
